invariantRules.text: Purchase or entitlement never creates installation, deployment, system, application or usage; provenance indicating such derivation is invalid.
Every entitlement references one authoritative agreement and one WM-SFT-001 product scope with declared scopeGranularity.
scopeGranularity is product, edition, release-family or release and the referenced identity remains mastered by WM-SFT-001.
Licence metric, quantity, territory, term and permitted-use constraints are effective-dated and historically resolvable.
EntitlementAllocation uses one typed consumerBinding of organization, software-system or business-application and has no redundant consumer fields.
At instant t, allocated quantity is the sum over active or provisioned allocations whose effective window covers t; the sum cannot exceed the entitlement effective at t under the same metric.
Reallocation closes or reduces predecessor allocations and conserves quantity before successor allocations become effective.
Assignment changes entitlement consumption without changing product, system or application identity.
Product upgrade eligibility never rewrites historical product scope; it creates a successor entitlement revision.
Suspension, expiry and termination stop effective authorization but preserve commercial and compliance history.
Renewal creates one successor entitlement revision linked by successorRef; an expired record is never silently extended.
Observed use and compliance verdicts remain external evidence and never mutate entitlement state by inference.
Hosted delivery may have entitlement and usage without local installation and records the absence explicitly.
Agreement duties and surviving restrictions remain externally mastered after entitlement termination.
Territory or permitted-use breach is a compliance finding and never silently expands entitlement scope.
Retired entitlement and allocation identifiers remain resolvable and are never recycled.
